rubric.why: The <font> tag changes the appearance of text on a web page.
rubric.description: States that the <font> tag changes or formats text.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying that the tag changes the text’s appearance.

rubric.why: The tag can set the font face, size, or color.
rubric.description: Names an attribute that the <font> tag can set.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the font face, size, or color.

modelAnswer: The <font> tag is used to change the appearance of text on a web page.
It can set the font face, size, and color.

items.followUp: Define a flowchart and explain how it helps in solving a problem.

rubric.why: An algorithm consists of a finite number of steps.
rubric.description: States that an algorithm has a finite set of steps.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the steps are finite.

rubric.why: An algorithm gives clear instructions in an ordered sequence.
rubric.description: Describes an algorithm as an ordered sequence of instructions.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the instructions as ordered or step-by-step.

rubric.why: An algorithm is designed to solve a problem.
rubric.description: States the purpose of an algorithm.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for connecting the algorithm to solving a problem.

rubric.why: An algorithm helps check the solution process or guide its implementation as a program.
rubric.description: Explains a further role of an algorithm in problem solving.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it helps check the steps or write/implement a program.

modelAnswer: An algorithm is a finite sequence of clear, ordered steps or instructions for solving a problem.
It provides a logical plan for reaching a solution.
It breaks the problem into manageable steps.
The steps can be checked and used to write a computer program.
